title: Flips, Rotations and Affine Warps
learning_objectives: Flip and rotate images by multiples of 90° with cv2.flip and cv2.rotate
Rotate about the centre with getRotationMatrix2D and warpAffine
Translate an image with a 2×3 affine matrix
entry_point: transform(image, op); rotate_about_centre(image, angle); translate(image, dx, dy)
hints: Map op names to `lambda img: cv2.flip(img, 1)`, `cv2.rotate(img, cv2.ROTATE_90_CLOCKWISE)` and so on.
`cv2.warpAffine(image, M, (w, h))` — the size is (width, height); for translation `M = np.float32([[1, 0, dx], [0, 1, dy]])`.

failure_feedback.advice: flip_h is cv2.flip(img, 1); flip_v is cv2.flip(img, 0).
The translation matrix is [[1, 0, dx], [0, 1, dy]].
